name: Wah Hong Industrial Corp.
summary: Wah Hong Industrial Corp. is a Taiwanese enterprise with a global presence, specializing in the research, manufacturing, and distribution of sophisticated plastic compounds and composite materials. Its extensive portfolio encompasses a wide array of advanced solutions. These include various optical films, such as diffusion, reflection, prism, quantum dot, and polarizing films, along with diffusion and guide plates, and essential materials for touch panels. Wah Hong also provides numerous precision coating products, including protective, screen protector, anti-shatter, and hard coating films, offering both standard products and OEM/ODM services. Furthermore, it supplies a diverse range of molding compounds (both bulk and precise), high-performance engineering plastics, various composite materials, and specialized dry BMCs and DAP pellets. For thermal management, the company develops high thermal conductivity composites, multi-functional heat-dissipating metallic materials, and custom thermal graphite products. Finally, it produces critical components for semiconductor manufacturing, specifically Chemical Mechanical Polishing (CMP) guide and retainer rings. These specialized materials find broad applications across key sectors, including sports equipment, automotive manufacturing, telecommunications, and consumer electronics. Established in 1973, the company is headquartered in Kaohsiung, Taiwan. It operated under the name Wah Hong Chemical Corp. until 1997 when it adopted its current designation, Wah Hong Industrial Corp.
